name: rating-rollover-by-tenant
evidence: pkg_rating.compute_rating rollover loop (03_pkg_rating.sql:87-92, ap-81929b0d21): rating_results joined to rating_periods by period_id, summed per tenant (the ADD_MONTHS window dropped so every rated period is covered)
source_sql: SELECT rp.tenant_id AS "tenantId", COUNT(rr.id) AS "ratedPeriods", NVL(SUM(rr.rollover_units), 0) AS "rolloverUnits" FROM rating_periods rp, rating_results rr WHERE rp.id = rr.period_id GROUP BY rp.tenant_id

name: rating-periods-by-tenant
evidence: pkg_rating.sp_finalize_rating upsert key (03_pkg_rating.sql:185-192, ap-8e58932397 / ap-8ee13949bc): one period per (tenant_id, period_start); periods per tenant with the covered span
source_sql: SELECT tenant_id AS "tenantId", COUNT(*) AS "periods", MIN(period_start) AS "firstPeriodStart", MAX(period_end) AS "lastPeriodEnd" FROM rating_periods GROUP BY tenant_id

name: rating-results-billable
evidence: pkg_rating.sp_finalize_rating result write (03_pkg_rating.sql:199-214, ap-d7af986eeb / ap-76af3595e0): the rated figures of every period that produced billable units or an overage amount
source_sql: SELECT id AS "resultId", period_id AS "periodId", subscription_id AS "subscriptionId", used_units AS "usedUnits", quota_units AS "quotaUnits", billable_units AS "billableUnits", overage_amount AS "overageAmount" FROM rating_results WHERE billable_units > 0 OR overage_amount > 0
